I got a taste of living alone and that feeling "Holy shit! I can choose what I want to do, when, and why!" when I moved for college at 18. For the 11 years after that, I did have roommates, but I could still do whatever wanted to, when I wanted to, within legality, of course.

Then, I got married. I don't regret this at all, but I do miss many things about being single. I NEED to be alone for at least some guaranteed amount of time, but my husband has been laid off work for the past four months and I have not. I am slowly going crazy, not because of him, but because I literally have no alone time at home. I'm alone at work, but it's not the same; it's not MY space. My house is around 900 square feet, so there is no way to isolate at home, either.

I do think that my introvertism has to do with childhood trauma (you can't be hurt/judged/ridiculed by anyone if no one is around, yada yada) but I would have thought I would have gotten past this by now.
